description: This source file defines protocols, structs, and an actor for managing WebSocket communication with a gateway service. It handles connection lifecycle, authentication, message sending/receiving, and reconnection logic, including error handling and token management.

classes.name: WebSocketTasking
classes.description: Protocol defining WebSocket task operations such as resume, cancel, send, receive, and sendPing.

classes.name: WebSocketSessioning
classes.description: Protocol for abstracting WebSocket session creation.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: A type-erased wrapper around a WebSocketTasking to provide a concrete, thread-safe interface.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: A wrapper holding an object conforming to WebSocketSessioning.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for establishing a gateway connection, including roles, scopes, permissions, and display name.

classes.name: GatewayAuthSource
classes.description: Enumeration of possible authentication sources used during connection.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: Actor managing WebSocket connection lifecycle, including connecting, reconnecting, messaging, and error handling.

methods.name: authSource
methods.description: Returns the last used authentication source.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the WebSocket connection and cancels background tasks.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes or re-establishes the WebSocket connection, performing authentication.

methods.name: startWatchdog
methods.description: Starts the watchdog task to monitor connection health and attempt reconnections.

methods.name: watchdogLoop
methods.description: Main loop for the watchdog to periodically attempt to reconnect if disconnected.

methods.name: keepaliveLoop
methods.description: Periodically sends ping messages to keep the connection alive.

methods.name: sendConnect
methods.description: Performs the WebSocket connect handshake, including authentication and device registration.

methods.name: selectConnectAuth
methods.description: Selects appropriate authentication tokens based on current state and config.

methods.name: handleConnectResponse
methods.description: Processes the response from the gateway after connecting, handling tokens and settings.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: handle(_ msg: URLSessionWebSocketTask.Message)
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages, dispatching events or responses.

methods.name: waitForConnectChallenge
methods.description: Waits for a challenge nonce required for device authentication.

methods.name: waitForConnectResponse
methods.description: Waits for a response to the connect request.

methods.name: encodeRequest
methods.description: Encodes a method call into WebSocket frame data.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request over WebSocket and awaits a response.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over WebSocket.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps low-level errors with context for better error reporting.

methods.name: connectOrThrow
methods.description: Attempts to connect, throwing an error on failure.

methods.name: scheduleReconnect
methods.description: Schedules a reconnection attempt with exponential backoff.

methods.name: handleReceiveFailure
methods.description: Handles failures during message reception, triggering reconnect if needed.

methods.name: decodeMessageData
methods.description: Decodes WebSocket message into Data.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Determines if a reconnection should retry with stored device token.

methods.name: shouldPauseReconnectAfterAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines if reconnection should be paused after an unrecoverable auth failure.

methods.name: shouldClearStoredDeviceTokenAfterRetry
methods.description: Checks if stored device token should be cleared after a mismatch error.

methods.name: isTrustedDeviceRetryEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the current host is trusted for device token retry (e.g., localhost).

methods.name: sleepUnlessCancelled
methods.description: Sleeps for a given duration unless the task is cancelled.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an authenticated request over WebSocket.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over WebSocket.

methods.name: timeoutRequest
methods.description: Handles request timeout by resuming with an error.
